openGraph.title: Dix Hectares
openGraph.description: Dix Hectares offers exceptional skincare products that are 100% natural, grown on the bicentennial Grand Cru terroir of Château Montrose, and formulated in harmony with the seasons for radiant skin that defies time with harmony. Clinically proven for sensitive skin.
